inner_cv.secondary_tie: largest equal-month NDCG@20%; tolerance 1e-12 then first grid index; never outer outcomes
inner_cv.selection: largest equal-month mean Spearman IC over all inner validation months; undefined IC contributes 0 for selection only, with count reported; at least one defined month required

library.choice: existing project optional ml dependency xgboost>=2.0 takes precedence over introducing LightGBM; no installation in this task
library.execution_requirement: human approval to implement/install exact version; CPU platform/OpenMP/package wheels must be recorded and deterministic repeat verified before execution

metrics.F3: all monthly IC, positive months, top-bottom, within-sector IC, sector-neutral spread explicitly reported
metrics.aggregation: equal TEST month weight; 36 pooled months and F1/F2/F3 separately; undefined IC excluded with explicit count; classification requires all 36 defined for trainable models
metrics.concentration: monthly issuer/sector counts, largest-sector/top3 shares already frozen in cohorts; entropy not implemented, not added
global: positive_IC_month_percentage denominator all months, undefined not positive
Q1-Q5 future_excess mean/median/outperform_rate/N and effective fractional N
NDCG@ceil(.10*N), NDCG@ceil(.20*N) linear integer decile gains; tie-averaged DCG; zero IDCG null

sector.IC: equal sector-month group weighted primary; observation-N weighted secondary
sector.demeaned: within same sector-month y-mean(y), evaluation only; global monthly Spearman(prediction, demeaned_y) on eligible sector groups; no training
sector.group: decision_month + frozen broad SIC sector CURRENT_PROFILE_NOT_PIT; descriptive evaluation only, never predictor
sector.small_groups: excluded only sector diagnostics; retained global
sector.spread: within-sector top/bottom20 same fractional ties; equal eligible sector weight within month then equal month aggregate
sector.undefined: explicit count; paired comparisons use identical defined month intersection

metrics.spread: fractional average-rank bin allocation to exactly .20*N top and bottom; arithmetic weighted future excess difference per month; units decimal return; quintiles same tie policy
